nina: Quick sync  need one-pager on MDF + credits tie to partner tiers for Tuesday QBR.

rob: Agreed. AMs confused about when to route to finance vs auto path.

kevin: Proposal: credits = marketing/listing spend (auto up to cap by tier); MDF = enablement/events/si uplift (requires score).

rob: Can we set static caps by tier? Bronze $2.5k, Silver $7.5k, Gold $15k, Platinum $30k per quarter?

kevin: Yeah. Also add a misuse guard: any partner with >2 denied requests in 90d loses auto privileges for a quarter.

finance-bot: Note: flag high-risk MDF (> $20k) with tag `requires_exec_approval`. Monthly reconciliation date 1800000000.

ops-bot: Suggest fields for webhook: partner_id, partner_tier, request_type, requested_amount, evidence_links, submitter.

nina: Action items: kevin drafts matrix + caps (today), rob writes AM FAQ examples (today), I'll schedule 15m QBR prep with AMs (tomorrow).

kevin: I'll post the matrix here once done.

rob: Thanks all :thumbsup:
